buttons.blockVariants: .button + variant-primary | variant-secondary | variant-tertiary | variant-icon-primary | variant-icon-secondary, color-skyblue | color-leafgreen, size-small | size-large, theme-dark; inner span .button-inner / .button-icon

projectHooks: scripts/scripts.js loadLazy: import('./fader.js') after loadSections (content fader)
scripts/martech.js loaded as before (loadConsent eager, loadTags delayed; every part off)

sharedModules.scripts/ft-ui.js: el(), icon(name, cls), loadSprite(), buildWave(color), loadChromeDoc(path), readLabels(sections), normPath(href), takeImage(node)
sharedModules.scripts/fader.js: initFader(main): sections after the first fade in on entry (.has-fader, [data-fader], .is-visible)

layout.gridPrimitive: display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--grid-columns), 1fr); column-gap: var(--grid-gap); padding-inline: var(--grid-padding); width: min(100%, var(--max-width)); margin-inline: auto

chrome.--nav-height: var(--topbar-height) — header reservation; main has no margin-top

breakpoints.designTarget: none set (DESIGN.json extensions.breakpoints.target absent) — lint:breakpoints skips
breakpoints.cap: 1920px (DESIGN.json shellMaxWidth / containerMaxWidth) via --max-width in every grid primitive

sectionStyles.wave-grey: background #f4f4f4 + the canon wave divider above the section (40px, 88px ≥1024)
sectionStyles.nightsky: background #001b6e, white text (also switches the breadcrumbs to their dark theme)
sectionStyles.defaultContent: main .section > .default-content-wrapper = canon RichtextSection/Richtext (prose column 2/-2 ≥768, 4/-4 ≥1024; h1–h4, p, lists, links)

header.breadcrumbsMetadata: breadcrumbs: auto | 'Home > Label > Label (/path)' (from stardust/rollout/chrome-map.json); absent = none
header.behaviour: click flyouts (one open, page darkened, scroll locked), search panel, meta menu, locale dialog (filter), mobile drawer levels 1–3, Escape + focus return, hide on scroll down / show on scroll up

chromeDocuments.media: stardust/rollout/media/chrome/*.png → DA media scope 'chrome' (da-media-upload.mjs --scope chrome --dir stardust/rollout/media/chrome) BEFORE the chrome docs are previewed
chromeDocuments.navModel: section 1 brand (logo img + home link); nested ul main nav; flat ul meta links; h2+h3 teasers; h2+ul locale selector; labels block (UI strings); metadata Robots noindex
chromeDocuments.footerModel: ul link lists; h2+ul social; h2+p>a newsletter; labels block (locale, locale-sr); metadata Robots noindex

icons: icons/sprite.svg (27 UI symbols, injected by loadSprite) + icons/<name>.svg for all 35 source symbols (EDS :name: icons)
